summary: The CascadingDropdown functionality in HSPnet.UI replaces dropdown controls with static text when certain conditions are met, ensuring that dropdowns that are disabled do not display a selected value.
purpose: To manage the visibility of dropdown controls and replace them with static text when they are disabled.

workflows.name: ReplaceDropdown
steps: Locate the dropdown control within the container using the dropdownName identifier.
Set the visibility of the dropdown control to false.
Locate the literal control within the container using the literalName identifier.
Set the visibility of the literal control to true.

business_rules: Disabled cascading dropdowns should not display their selected value.
system_behavior: Dropdown controls are made invisible when they meet the criteria for replacement.
Literal controls are made visible to display static text.
